name: Ease Curve
summary: Applies speed easing curves to video playback using cubic bezier functions or preset easing modes. Allows variable-speed effects and smooth acceleration/deceleration.

inputs.description: Input video clip to apply easing curve to.

outputs.description: Video with applied easing curve and variable playback speed.
The applied bezier easing curve data, exportable to other nodes for synchronization.

executionNotes: Implements cubic bezier easing (P0=(0,0), P1=(x1,y1), P2=(x2,y2), P3=(1,1)) stored as bezierHandles [x1, y1, x2, y2]. Preset easing modes include 'ease-in', 'ease-out', 'ease-in-out', 'linear', 'bounce', 'elastic'. If easingPreset is set, bezierHandles are derived from the preset. inheritedFrom tracks upstream easing chains. outputDuration adapts based on speed variations. Progress (0-100) tracks encoding. encoderSupported indicates browser video codec capability. All calculations done in browser using requestAnimationFrame.

exampleConnections.scenario: Apply ease-in effect to a trimmed video clip for smooth acceleration.
Export easing curve data as JSON for conditional routing or analysis.
